name: Stone Bones
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 10 min./level

DESCRIPTION

When you drink this extract, you can feel your bones calcifying and, for a brief moment, your limbs seem too heavy to move. For the duration of this extract, your bones are as hard as stone, and this effect grants you DR 5/piercing and reduces by half any falling damage you sustain.
